subject: QTL analysis on a F3 population

messages.author: 5279e97a1a3d175c
messages.subject: QTL analysis on a F3 population
parts: Hello, Is it possible to do a QTL analysis on a F3 population (SSD from the F2) of which the F3 plants are genotyped and the F4 is phenotyped?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] QTL analysis on a F3 population
parts:
Not really. R/qtl allows one individual phenotype per genotype, so you'd need to average the F4 measures from a given F3. And R/qtl doesn't have code to explicitly treat F3 individuals, so you'd need to treat them as an F2.

karl
